metadata.metaValue:
Scatter points is scattering points on our dummy geometry. 

By default it creates orientations from the mesh you scatter on, either based on UVs or connectivity. We use those orientations in this example. 

The local Y axis of the instance points along the normal.  The local Z axis points along the tangent. 

Tangents can be based on the mesh's structure (connectivity) or the mesh's UV coordinates. You can also provide your own data for normals or tangents.
